inputs.original_text: Former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader Job Sikhala has called for the rejection of proposed constitutional amendments reportedly aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term of office to 2030. Addressing members of the media at a press conference, Sikhala criticised what he described as [...] The post Sikhala Takes Aim at Constitutional Amendment Bill 3 appeared first on 263Chat .
inputs.modified_text: This is bigger than one politician’s objection. The proposed amendments are reportedly designed to keep Emmerson Mnangagwa in office until 2030, and the push to change the rules looks like a coordinated effort to dress up a power grab as constitutional process. Job Sikhala is calling for rejection, but the real question is who benefits from rewriting the rules—and what they’re hoping the public won’t notice.
